articles.title: Trump’s Golf Course Plans Hit a Legal Obstacle: His Own Social Media Posts
articles.summary: President Donald Trump faced a legal setback on Saturday when a federal judge temporarily blocked the planned closure of a public golf course and surrounding parkland in Washington, D.C. Among the evidence undermining his Administration’s justification: his own Truth Social posts. articles.summary: In the future, when some documentary series in whatever medium succeeds television looks back at the current decade in public discourse, it might name our era the Age of Ignorance. articles.title: Air Traffic Control Systems Are Outdated. What’s Being Done to Prevent Another Outage?
articles.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy on Saturday blamed the previous day’s nationwide ground stop on the replacement of copper wires at a “remote” Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) facility. Installing new fiber optic lines led to critical communication breakdowns, he said. About 7,500 flights were delayed and over 9,000 were canceled on Friday, according to FlightAware . articles.title: The China Shock in the AI Era
articles.summary: Americans are anxious about artificial intelligence . In the midterm elections , they voted to slow down its expansion. Forty local ballot measures in 10 states promise to tighten restrictions on data-center construction, with overwhelming public support. Measures to limit development of data centers won more than 70% of the vote in 30 of these electoral contests. articles.title: Congress Must Protect the CDC From Politics
articles.summary: Democrats and Republicans in the new Congress will disagree about plenty in health policy. However, they should agree that the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) should be a scientific agency whose judgments hold steady no matter who occupies the White House. In January, Congress will have the chance to write that principle into law. For decades, the scientific independence of America’s public health agencies rested on a bipartisan understanding.
